notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.17 highlights:**

- Import several Excel worksheets at once
- The AI Assist Model field says what it accepts
- The evaluation now ends in read-only, and licenses honor their update window
- Support is support@jnanalabs.com
- Logs record less
- Keyboard, screen-reader and dark-mode fixes from the accessibility review
- Exports never replace your previous file with a broken one
- Projects under very long folder paths work on Windows
- Autosave keeps working after a project opens with sync damage
- Autosave can no longer stop quietly
- An unexpected error now tells you, instead of only writing to the log
- About and Copy Diagnostics now carry the facts a support reply needs
- Exports never contact the network
- First launch: choosing *Open a sample manuscript* in the welcome dialog no longer opens the sample's Save dialog on top of the start window
- Hostile equations, citation styles and reference files can no longer freeze or crash the app
- A damaged or hostile project file can no longer break an open, a save, or an import
- Online lookups cope with a bad network, and your AI key stays on one host
- Double-clicking a project now opens it
- Projects shared between different Manuscript versions no longer lose settings, and a project from a newer version is refused safely
- Saving and opening on cloud-synced or read-only folders is safer
- A damaged settings file no longer crashes startup or vanishes
- A shared project can no longer read files off your computer
- Clicking into a partially visible table cell now puts the caret where you clicked
- Guideline links open only as web links, and files the app brings in are quarantined like browser downloads
- Updating Manuscript in place no longer loses settings, re-arms a spent trial extension, hides new releases or covers a restored draft
